description: TMS - Verkehrsnetz der Bundeswasserstraßen (VerkNet BWaStr) - Tilecache nach TMS Standard is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by FGeoWSV - Fachstelle für Geodäsie und Geoinformatik der Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung des Bundes. This TMS visualizes the federal traffic network of the federal waterways (VerkNet-BWaStr). The VerkNet-BWaStr is a topologically linked vector dataset of all federal waterways (BWaStr). This basic geodataset of the Federal Waterways and Shipping Administration (WSV) is used for the continuous station-related georeferencing of all WSV data with direct and indirect spatial reference. Coverage: FGeoWSV - Fachstelle für Geodäsie und Geoinformatik der Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung des Bundes. The portal shows the English title as "TMS - Transport network of federal waterways (VerkNet BWaStr) - Tilecache according to TMS standard" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is FGeoWSV - Fachstelle für Geodäsie und Geoinformatik der Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung des Bundes. Its keywords include Transport, Binnenschiffahrt, Schiffahrt, verknet, opendata, Bundeswassertraßen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read).
